BatchDeleteSynonyms.description_en: Delete synonyms in bulk from the specified workspace
BatchDeleteSynonyms.description_zh: 批量删除当前指定业务空间下的同义词

CancelDatasourceAuthorization.description_en: Cancels authorization for an associated data source
CancelDatasourceAuthorization.description_zh: 取消关联的数据源授权

CreateBusinessLogic.description_en: Creates a business logic definition in the specified workspace
CreateBusinessLogic.description_zh: 在指定的业务空间下创建新的业务逻辑解释

CreateDatasourceAuthorization.description_en: Creates an authorization to associate a data source with a specified workspace. After the association is created, you can retrieve the table schema from the data source
CreateDatasourceAuthorization.description_zh: 创建数据库关联授权，在您指定的业务空间，对指定的数据源进行关联关系的创建，创建后可以对数据源下的表结构进行采集

CreateSynonyms.description_en: Creates a synonym in the specified workspace
CreateSynonyms.description_zh: 在当前指定的业务空间下面，新建同义词

CreateVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_en: Creates a virtual data source instance in the specified workspace. This instance represents a virtual database. You can add Data Definition Language (DDL) statements to it to build virtual databases and tables
CreateVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_zh: 在您指定的业务空间创建虚拟数据源实例，虚拟数据源实例代表着一个虚拟的数据库，可以向虚拟数据源中添加ddl语句，来完成您构建虚拟数据库，数据表的能力

DeleteBusinessLogic.description_en: Delete a business logic definition from the specified workspace
DeleteBusinessLogic.description_zh: 删除指定业务空间下所指定的业务逻辑解释

DeleteColumn.description_en: Delete a column from the specified workspace
DeleteColumn.description_zh: 从当前所指定的业务空间中，删除所指定的列

DeleteSelectedTable.description_en: Deletes the specified data table from the designated workspace
DeleteSelectedTable.description_zh: 将当前指定数据表从指定业务空间管控中删除

DeleteVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_en: Deletes a virtual data source instance in the specified workspace
DeleteVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_zh: 删除指定业务空间下面的虚拟数据源实例

ListBusinessLogic.description_en: Lists the definitions of enterprise knowledge terms in the specified workspace
ListBusinessLogic.description_zh: 获取当前指定业务空间下的企业知识名词解释列表

ListColumn.description_en: Retrieve column information for a specified table in the current workspace
ListColumn.description_zh: 获取当前指定业务空间，指定表下面的列信息

ListEnumMapping.description_en: Retrieve enumeration values for the specified table and column within the current workspace
ListEnumMapping.description_zh: 获取当前业务空间，指定表、列下的枚举值

ListSelectedTables.description_en: Retrieve the data tables associated with the current workspace
ListSelectedTables.description_zh: 获取当前业务空间处于以关联状态的数据表

ListSynonyms.description_en: Lists synonyms in a specified workspace
ListSynonyms.description_zh: 获取当前指定业务空间下的同义词列表

ListVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_en: Retrieve the list of data source instances in the current workspace
ListVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_zh: 获取当前业务空间下的数据源实例列表

RecoverColumn.description_en: Restores a data column in a specified data table to its initial state
RecoverColumn.description_zh: 将指定数据表的数据列恢复到初始化关联时的状态

ResyncTable.description_en: Refreshes information about the associated data table from the remote database
ResyncTable.description_zh: 从远程数据库刷新当前所关联的数据表信息

RunDataAnalysis.description_en:
Xianyan provides you with OpenAPI operations that deliver the same conversational experience as the official console. By simply passing parameters such as workspaceId and query, you can perform Q&A and data analytics on your pre-created workspace.

This API operation is suitable for the following scenario:  
You have associated a data source in the Xianyan console, allowing Xianyan to access your database and execute SQL queries either over the Internet or through a VPC.

For detailed usage instructions, refer to the following Best Practices document:  
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/gbi-best-practices
RunDataAnalysis.description_zh:
析言为您提供了与官方页面对话效果相同的OpenAPI接口，只需传入workspaceId以及query等相关信息，即可对您已经创建好的业务空间进行问答和数据分析。

该接口适合以下场景：
您在析言控制台关联了数据源，即析言可以通过公网或者VPC的方式访问您的数据库并执行SQL。

具体的使用，可以参考以下最佳实践文档：
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/gbi-best-practices

RunDataResultAnalysis.description_en: Analyze the execution results of structured data types and generate visualization information.
RunDataResultAnalysis.description_zh: 对结构化数据类型的执行结果进行分析、可视化信息生成

RunSqlGeneration.description_en: This operation generates SQL statements based on the current query information and associated data tables. This API is suitable for scenarios where your database is stored locally and cannot be accessed by Xiyan. You can associate a virtual data source with Xiyan, call this API to generate the SQL statements, and then parse and execute them locally. For more information, see the best practices document
RunSqlGeneration.description_zh:
运行sql生成，根据当前的query信息，结合已关联的数据表，进行sql语句的生成。

该接口适合以下场景：
您的数据库在本地，不能被析言访问。
您可以通过析言关联虚拟数据源，调用该接口生成SQL，然后自行解析和执行SQL。

具体的使用，可以参考以下最佳实践文档：
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/xiyan-gbi-local-data-best-practices

SaveVirtualDatasourceDdl.description_en: Add DDL statements to a virtual data source instance in your current workspace. Alibaba Cloud GBI parses these DDL statements to extract and maintain table schema information
SaveVirtualDatasourceDdl.description_zh: 向您当前指定的业务空间下指定的虚拟数据源实例中添加ddl语句，析言GBI云服务会将您的ddl语句解析成相关的表结构信息并进行维护

SyncRemoteTables.description_en: Update the data tables associated with your workspace by syncing the latest tables from a remote virtual data source and associating them with the specified workspace
SyncRemoteTables.description_zh: 更新当前业务空间所关联的数据表，从远程数据源（虚拟数据源）同步最近的表并关联到您所指定的业务空间

UpdateBusinessLogic.description_en: Update a business logic description in the specified Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace
UpdateBusinessLogic.description_zh: 修改当前指定业务空间下所指定的业务逻辑解释

UpdateColumn.description_en: Updates column information in the specified workspace
UpdateColumn.description_zh: 修改当前指定业务空间中，指定列的信息

UpdateEnumMapping.description_en: Modifies the enumeration mapping for a specified column in a workspace
UpdateEnumMapping.description_zh: 修改当前指定业务空间指定列下的枚举值信息

UpdateSynonyms.description_en: Update synonym information in the current workspace
UpdateSynonyms.description_zh: 修改当前业务空间指定的同义词信息

UpdateTableInfo.description_en: Updates information for a specified data table
UpdateTableInfo.description_zh: 修改当前所指定的数据表的信息

UpdateVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_en: Updates the information of a virtual data source in a specified workspace
UpdateVirtualDatasourceInstance.description_zh: 修改指定业务空间下所指定的虚拟数据源的信息
